-- SHIP SCRIPT V6.1 21/01/2026
-- Updated UI with Radial Movement and Firing Arcs

-- 30mm
 local BigUI_Height = -700
 local SmallUI_Height = -680

RSS_Class = 'Model';

------ RADIAL MOVEMENT CONFIGURATION ----------------------
local MAX_RANGE = 10
local MAX_TURN_ANGLE = 45
local MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD = 0.1
local SMOOTH_SPEED = 6
local MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS = true
local DRAW_RAIL_LINE = true
local UNIT_SCALE = 1.0
local LINE_Y_OFFSET = 0.3

-- Movement state variables
local isHeld = false
local holdingPlayerColor = nil
local pivotPosition = nil
local originalPivotPosition = nil  -- stores pivot from phase 1
local startRotation = nil
local startForwardVec = nil
local currentSmoothedPos = nil
local courseChangePhase = 1  -- Track phase for Course Change: 1 or 2
local courseChangeDistance = 0  -- Track distance moved in phase 1
local pickupPosition = nil
local pickupRotation = nil

-- Cached visual lines
local cachedFiringArcLines = nil
local cachedScanLines = nil
local cachedSignatureLines = nil

------ CLASS VARIABLES ----------------------

local ChildObjs = {
    aura_obj = nil,
    sig_aura_obj = nil,
	measurement_line = nil
};

-- Declare global variables at the beginning
TEXT_COLOR = TEXT_COLOR or "#FFFFFFFF"
OUTLINE_COLOR = OUTLINE_COLOR or "#000000"
OUTLINE_SIZE = OUTLINE_SIZE or "2 2"
local Shiphealth = 66       -- health variable
local ShipbaseSize = 40     -- base size variable
local Shipcost = 666        -- cost variable
local ShipScan = 66          -- Scan range in inches (NEW)
local ShipThrust = 66 		-- Ship Thrust Value
local Signature = 66        -- Ship Signature Variable

local SignatureStorage = 35  -- Used for keeping track of signature
local cloaked = 0           -- Tracker for Silent running
local BROADCAST_CHANNEL = "Ship_Activation_Reset"
local arcsProjected = 0  -- Tracker for projected arcs

local SHIPCardURL = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9676758734292095/FE0FE086CB3EE555C341EB422818ACF1E9375EFB/"

local MenuManager = nil
local MenuManagerGUID = "15fc7f"  -- Replace this with the actual GUID of your Move Manager

-- state.positionHistory = {}  -- Array to store position history
-- local MAX_HISTORY = 10     -- Maximum number of positions to remember
-- local POSITION_CHECK_INTERVAL = 1  -- How often to check position (in seconds)
-- local lastPosition = nil    -- Last recorded position
-- local lastCheckTime = 0    -- Time of last position check

local originalData = nil;
local state = {
    conditions = {
        Navigation_Offline = 0, Orbital_Decay = 0, Fire = 0, Weapons_Offline = 0,
        Scanners_Offline = 0, Defence_Systems_Offline = 0, Spikes = 0, Aura = 0,
		Activated = 0, Mode = 0, Atmosphere = 0, Clockwise = 0, CounterClockwise = 0,
		Silent_Running = 0, ProjectArcs = 0, ShipCard = 0, Status = 0, SpecialOrders = 0, MoveOff = 0
    },
    tokens = {},
    health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth },
    base = { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 255, g = 255, b = 255} },
    imageScale = 1.5,
    moveHistory = {},
    sigAuraShown = false,
    sig = Signature,
    referenceCard = { GUID = '', obj = nil },
    positionHistory = {},
    moveNumber = 5,
    fractionNumber = 0,
    statusMenuOpen = false,
    specialOrdersMenuOpen = false,
    activeSpecialOrder = "GeneralQuarters"
};

local UIStatus = {
    Blue = { rotation = -2 },
    Red = { rotation = -2 },
    Black = { rotation = -2 },
    Grey = { rotation = -2 }
};

-- New variable to track the current UI mode
local currentUIMode = 1  -- 0: High Visibility, 1: Subtle, 2: Compact

-- Add this at the top of your script
local UI_SCALE = 1.3  -- Adjust this value to scale all UI elements
local BACKGROUND_COLOR = "#000000CC"  -- More opaque background
local TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFFFF"  -- Bright white text
local OUTLINE_COLOR = "#000000"
local OUTLINE_SIZE = "2 2"  -- Thicker outline

------ RADIAL MOVEMENT FUNCTIONS --------------------

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    -- Calculate scan radius to match scan lines
    local scanRadius = ShipScan

    -- Helper to add symmetric lines with custom color
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        -- Line 1 (Right side) - extends from -scanRadius to +scanRadius
        local p1 = rotRight * scanRadius
        local p2 = rotRight * (-scanRadius)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * scanRadius
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-scanRadius)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    -- Front/Side/Rear (45 degrees) - Dark Red
    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})

    -- Front/Rear Narrow (11 degrees) - Dark Blue
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green

    -- Circle Scan Range - use ShipScan variable
    -- Use 10/3 multiplier to match TTS scale correctly
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function onPickUp(player_color)
    -- Check if MoveOff is active - if so, skip radial movement setup
    if state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0 then
        isHeld = false
        return
    end

    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color

    -- Store pickup position/rotation for undo (do this FIRST)
    pickupPosition = self.getPosition()
    pickupRotation = self.getRotation()

    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()  -- Always use current position as pivot
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()

    -- For Course Change: check if we're starting a new maneuver or continuing to phase 2
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- If we just dropped and are picking up again, move to phase 2
        if courseChangePhase == 1 and courseChangeDistance > 0 then
            courseChangePhase = 2
            print("[FFAA00]Course Change: Phase 2 - Turn up to 45° more (total 90°), NO MOVEMENT [-]")
        else
            -- Starting fresh phase 1
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
        end
    else
        -- Reset for other orders
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
    end

    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

function onDrop(player_color)
    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil

    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))

    -- For Course Change: lock distance after phase 1 drop
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and courseChangePhase == 1 then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
        local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
        local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

        if movedDistance > 0.1 then  -- Minimum movement threshold
            courseChangeDistance = movedDistance
            print("[22AA22]Course Change: Phase 1 complete - Moved " .. string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) .. " inches. Pick up again to turn additional 45° [-]")
        else
            -- Reset if they didn't actually move
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
        end
    end

    -- Update visuals based on Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()

    -- Get movement parameters based on active special order
    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()

    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()

    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition

        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()

    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)

    -- Check if angle exceeds limit (use dynamic max turn angle)
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC then
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    end

    -- 4. Calculate New Position with MIN and MAX range
    local targetPos  -- Declare here so it's available throughout the function

    -- Special handling for Course Change order
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        if courseChangePhase == 1 then
            -- Phase 1: Normal movement up to half thrust
            local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
            local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
            local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
            targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
        else
            -- Phase 2: NO MOVEMENT - ship stays at pivot position and only rotates
            targetPos = pivotPosition
            -- Note: Rotation is handled separately below in step 5
        end
    else
        -- Standard clamping for other orders
        local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
        local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
        local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
        targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
    end

    -- Preserve the object's current height
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y

    -- Smooth interpolation
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y
    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)

    -- 5. Calculate Rotation
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))

    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add Aura visuals if enabled (firing arcs + scan)
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0

        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        -- Use dynamic max range for visual
        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Use dynamic max turn angle for limit lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Main range line (white)
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })

        -- Only draw turn limit lines if turning is allowed
        if MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC > 0 then
            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end

        -- Draw minimum range circle if MIN_RANGE > 0
        if MIN_RANGE > 0 then
            local minCirclePoints = {}
            local segments = 32
            local step = 360 / segments
            for i = 0, segments do
                local angle = math.rad(i * step)
                local x = math.cos(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local z = math.sin(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local worldPos = pivotPosition + Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z)
                table.insert(minCirclePoints, self.positionToLocal(worldPos))
            end

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = minCirclePoints,
                color = {1, 1, 0},  -- Yellow for minimum range
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return  -- Don't generate if not shown or sig is 0
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}  -- Red for signature

    -- Calculate signature radius
    local sigRadius = state.sig * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15  -- Slightly thicker than scan lines
    })
end

function getMovementParameters()
    -- Safety check - ensure ShipThrust exists
    if not ShipThrust or ShipThrust == 0 then
        ShipThrust = 9  -- Default value
    end

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    local halfThrust = ShipThrust / 2
    local fullThrust = ShipThrust
    local doubleThrust = ShipThrust * 2

    -- Return: minRange, maxRange, maxTurnAngle
    if activeOrder == "GeneralQuarters" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, turn up to 45°
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 45

    elseif activeOrder == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, NO TURNING
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "WeaponsFree" then
        -- Move between half and full thrust, NO TURNING
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- Phase 1: Turn up to 45°, move up to half thrust
        -- Phase 2: Turn another 45° (total 90°), NO MOVEMENT AT ALL
        if courseChangePhase == 1 then
            return 0, halfThrust, 45
        else
            -- Phase 2: ZERO movement, can only rotate
            return 0, 0, 45  -- Changed from courseChangeDistance to 0,0
        end

    elseif activeOrder == "MaxThrust" then
        -- Move between full and double thrust, NO TURNING
        return fullThrust, doubleThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "DamageControl" then
        -- Turn up to 45°, move up to half thrust
        return 0, halfThrust, 45

    else
        -- Default to General Quarters
        return halfThrust, fullThrust, 45
    end
end

function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
        for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

------ LIFE CYCLE EVENTS --------------------

function onLoad(save)
    -- Decode save data
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or {}
    state.moveNumber = data.moveNumber or 5
    state.fractionNumber = data.fractionNumber or 0

	if data.SHIPCardURL then
        SHIPCardURL = data.SHIPCardURL
    end

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- REMOVE all position tracking initialization
    -- Just initialize pickup vars as nil
    pickupPosition = nil
    pickupRotation = nil

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Ensure Move Manager registration
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("RegisterToken", { obj = self, guid = self.getGUID() })
    else
        print("Error: Could not find Move Manager object.")
    end

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage with the saved base signature value, not the current sig
    SignatureStorage = data.baseSignature or state.sig or Signature

    -- Generate firing arc and scan lines
    generateFiringArcLines()
    generateScanLines()

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showMeasurementLine()

    -- Recalculate signature based on the loaded base value and current spikes
    RecalculateSignature()

    -- Update visuals based on loaded Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function onClick(player_color)
    -- Call StartControlledMove for both tokens
    if MenuManager then
        MenuManager.call("StartControlledMove", {
            color = player_color,
            obj = self
        })
    end
end

function onDestroy()
    -- Safely destroy child objects
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj ~= nil then ChildObjs.aura_obj.destruct() end
    -- Removed: if ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj ~= nil then ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj.destruct() end
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line ~= nil then ChildObjs.measurement_line.destruct() end

    -- Reset ProjectArcs condition safely
    if state and state.conditions and state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 then
        state.conditions.ProjectArcs = 0
    end
end

function onSave()
    local data = {}
    data.state = state
    data.originalData = originalData ~= nil and originalData or state
    -- REMOVED: data.positionHistory = state.positionHistory
    data.moveNumber = state.moveNumber
    data.fractionNumber = state.fractionNumber
    data.baseSignature = SignatureStorage
	data.SHIPCardURL = SHIPCardURL
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onUpdate()
    if not state or not state.conditions then return end

    -- Handle radial movement when held (but not if MoveOff is active)
    if isHeld and pivotPosition and holdingPlayerColor and (not state.conditions.MoveOff or state.conditions.MoveOff == 0) then
        local player = Player[holdingPlayerColor]
        if player then
            updateRadialMovement(player)
        else
            onDrop(nil)
        end
    end

    -- Add safe checks for ProjectArcs condition
    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and
       ((ChildObjs.aura_obj) or (state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj)) then
        ProjectArcsForward()
    end

    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerSuscribed(player.color) then
            HUDLookAtPlayer(player)
        end
    end
    -- trackPosition()

    -- Update measurement line when ship rotates
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({0, rotation.y + 90, 0})
    end
end

-- Add a new function to modify the fraction number
function UI_ModifyFractionNumber(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        ModifyCondition({
            name = "FractionNumber",
            amount = (alt == '-1' and 1 or (alt == '-2' and -1) or 0)
        })
        showMeasurementLine()  -- Update the measurement line
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or 20
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil
    local conditionNames = {
        "Navigation_Offline", "Orbital_Decay", "Fire", "Weapons_Offline",
        "Scanners_Offline", "Defence_Systems_Offline", "Spikes", "Aura",
        "Activated", "Mode", "Atmosphere", "Silent_Running", "Clockwise",
        "CounterClockwise", "MoveNumber", "ShipCard", "Status", "SpecialOrders",
        "TargetSig", "ProjectArcs", "MoveOff", "Rewind", "FractionNumber", "Move"
    }

    for _, condName in ipairs(conditionNames) do
        state.conditions[condName] = state.conditions[condName] or 0
    end

    -- Ensure state.base.color is properly set and valid
    state.base.color = state.base.color or {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}

    -- Ensure menu state fields exist
    state.statusMenuOpen = state.statusMenuOpen or false
    state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = state.specialOrdersMenuOpen or false
    state.activeSpecialOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

end

------ STATE ACTIONS ------------------------

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;
    SignatureStorage = newState.sig; -- Set SignatureStorage to the initial sig value
    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, state.health.current + params.amount));
    SyncHealth()
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    -- clamp to 0/1 so it can never stack
    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end


function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        -- Regenerate signature lines if they're being shown
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        generateSignatureLines()  -- Generate the circle
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        cachedSignatureLines = nil  -- Clear the lines
    end
    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function RefreshModelShape()
    local attachments = self.getAttachments()
    for key, value in pairs(attachments) do
        local modelElement = self.removeAttachment(0)
        if modelElement then
            modelElement.setCustomObject({
                image_scalar = tonumber(state.imageScale * 1)
            });
            self.addAttachment(modelElement)
        end
    end
    RefreshBaseColor()
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Temporarily force specific values
    state.base.color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1}

    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Fully opaque
        else
            adjustTransparency(baseColor, 255)  -- Slight transparency
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs({'Red', 'Blue', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        -- Special handling for Status button - show active if any critical status is active
        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url

        local colorBlock
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
        else
            colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        --RefreshBaseColor()
        ApplyActivatedLockState()
    end
end

function SelectSpecialOrder(orderName)
    -- Check if we're switching away from Silent Running Order
    local wasOnSilentRunning = (state.activeSpecialOrder == "SilentRunningOrder")

    state.activeSpecialOrder = orderName
    state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
    state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0

    -- Reset Course Change phases when changing orders
    courseChangePhase = 1
    courseChangeDistance = 0

    -- Handle Silent Running activation/deactivation
    if orderName == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        -- Activate Silent Running
        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 1
        cloaked = 1
        print("Special Order selected: Silent Running Order - Signatur Set to 0")
        RecalculateSignature()
        SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
    elseif wasOnSilentRunning then
        -- Deactivate Silent Running when switching away from Silent Running Order
        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 0
        cloaked = 0
        print("Special Order selected: " .. orderName .. " - Signature Restored")
        RecalculateSignature()
        SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
    else
        print("Special Order selected: " .. orderName)
    end

    Sync()
end

function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            if not self.getLock() then
                self.setLock(true)
            end

            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1

            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            self.setPosition(newPos)

            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()

            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"
            print(modelName .. " has moved " ..
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " ..
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")

            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end

    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())

        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)

        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, moveAmount * ARROW_WIDTH})
        else
            ChildObjs.measurement_line = spawnObject({
                type = 'Custom_Model',
                position = arrowPos,
                rotation = {
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                    rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
                },
                scale = {ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, ARROW_WIDTH},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    obj.setColorTint(ARROW_COLOR)
                    obj.setVar('parent', self)
                    obj.setLuaScript([[
                        local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_Y_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1] .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3] .. [[

                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                local shipPos = parent.getPosition()
                                local shipRot = parent.getRotation()

                                local shipAngle = math.rad(shipRot.y)
                                local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

                                local arrowPos = {
                                    x = shipPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
                                    y = shipPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
                                    z = shipPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
                                }

                                self.setPosition(arrowPos)
                                self.setRotation({
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X,
                                    shipRot.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    obj.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })

            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                type = 0,
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0.1,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    else
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        end
    end
end

function RefreshShip()
    local currentState = {
        conditions = state.conditions,
        health = state.health,
        base = state.base,
        imageScale = state.imageScale,
        sig = state.sig,
        sigAuraShown = state.sigAuraShown,
    }

    rebuildAssets()

    Wait.frames(function()
        for key, value in pairs(currentState) do
            state[key] = value
        end

        self.UI.setXml(ui())
        Sync()
        RefreshModelShape()
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            showSigAura()
        end
        showMeasurementLine()

        RecalculateSignature()

        print(self.getName() .. " has been refreshed.")
    end, 2)
end
